in_arabic.name: راحة
in_arabic.meaning: الراحة و السكون و الراحة من التعب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم يعني الراحة و السكون و الراحة من التعب، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و في الحديث النبوي الشريف، و يعني الاسم الراحة و الاطمئنان و السكينة، و هو اسم جميل و رائع و يحمل معاني إيجابية

in_urdu.name: راحت
in_urdu.meaning: آرام، سکون، راحت، تکان سے بالاءتی
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم 'راحت' کا مطلب ہے آرام، سکون، راحت، تکان سے بالاءتی۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'راحت' یا 'سکون'۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اہل سنت والجمہیر کے مذہبی علماء نے اس نام کو مستحسن قرار دیا ہے

in_hindi.name: راحت
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम 'راحت' का अर्थ है आराम, सुख, शांति, सुकून। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'आराम' या 'शांति'। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रयोग होता है, जहां यह नाम बच्चों के लिए एक शुभ और पवित्र नाम माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: راحت
in_pashto.long_meaning: د 'راحت' نوم معنی دی آرام، راحت، سکون، ارامش. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چي معنی یې 'آرام' یا 'سکون' دی. دا نوم د افغانستان په پښتنو ټولنو کې هم کارول کیږي، چیرته چې دا د ماشومانو لپاره یو ښکلی او پاک نوم ګڼل کیږي

in_english.name: Rahat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rahat originates from the Arabic root 'r-h-w' which signifies 'to be at ease' or 'to be comfortable'. It is mentioned in the Quran and Hadith, symbolizing comfort, peace, and tranquility. In Islamic tradition, Rahat is considered a beautiful name that embodies positive qualities and connotations. It is widely used across Muslim cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and significance

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Rahat' holds significant cultural impact as it is a name that signifies a sense of calmness, peace, and comfort. In many Islamic cultures, the name is given to infants to instill a deep sense of tranquility and serenity within them. The name has lingual roots that signify an inner stability and an external environment that is relaxed and hassle-free. Rahat is a name that is hoped to bring relief and assurance to both the person bearing the name and those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Rahat' holds deep spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition, as it is derived from the Arabic word for 'comfort' and 'rest.' In the Quran, Allah (God) promises comfort and peace to those who believe and follow His teachings. 'Rahat' can also be seen as a reminder of the ultimate comfort and mercy that awaits believers in the Hereafter, as defined in the following verse: "But those who believe and work righteousness, Allah will admit them into gardens under which rivers flow. They will abide therein, Allah being pleased with them, and they with Him. That will be the great success." (Quran 47:15) 'Rahat' can serve as a constant reminder for the person bearing the name and for all believers to seek comfort and ease in following Allah's path and to find peace in Allah's love and mercy.
